_readme: v7.4.16 §1.4 Component B. Every entry MUST carry a sourceGuide and a sourceLine quoting the verified guide it came from (CR2: no invented dollars). Deltas are per-unit savings from choosing the honest option over the premium one. At most ONE entry applies per read. To add an entry, quote a real figure from a real guide — a ratio ('5x the price') is not a figure and cannot seed an entry.

entries.sourceLine: Custom acrylic interior storm inserts (Indow-style, $400+/window — premium tier when film does 80% of the job)
Designer insulated curtains ($150-300/window — same R-value as $40 thermal liner)
entries.basis: designer curtains at $150-300 vs thermal liner at $40
